text_block_list.text: I'm gonna give it my all today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I showed such a pathetic side of myself 
to Trainer-kun and the juniors last time, 
after all."

to Trainer-chan and the juniors last time, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:

track so fast everyone's jaws are gonna 
hit the floor!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer-kun! All right, let's do 
this!
